assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis code I25.10 is assigned for atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnosis code I34.0 is assigned for nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for underlying rhythm disturbances
The CPT code for long-term continuous ECG monitoring is 93247
The service provides continuous monitoring required to identify intermittent rhythm disturbances consistent with the member's presentation
